story.zh: 黄巾之乱时，卢植围攻张角，左丰索贿不成，诬其“惰慢军心”，卢植被罢官下狱。乱平后卢植仍陷囹圄，刘备决意营救恩师。
story.en: During the Yellow Turban Rebellion, Lu Zhi besieged Zhang Jiao. When Zuo Feng failed to extort a bribe from him, he falsely accused Lu Zhi of ‘slackness and undermining army morale,’ leading to Lu Zhi being stripped of his post and imprisoned. Even after the rebellion was quelled, Lu Zhi remained behind bars, and Liu Bei resolved to rescue his former mentor.

trigger.zh: 刘备、关羽、张飞、简雍、卢植、皇甫嵩、朱儁、汉灵帝、何进、十常侍、袁绍存活且在正确势力。
trigger.en: Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Jian Yong, Lu Zhi, Huangfu Song, Zhu Jun, Emperor Ling of Han, He Jin, the Ten Attendants, and Yuan Shao are alive and in the correct Factions.

forbidden.zh: 主角为卢植、皇甫嵩、朱儁、何进、十常侍时无法触发
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Lu Zhi, Huangfu Song, Zhu Jun, He Jin, or one of the Ten Attendants
